rationale: The text describes innovation management through discussion, sharing and commenting on ideas, team and topic views, routing, evaluation, tracking, and reporting.
evidence_spans: Brightidea is a cloud-based innovation management solution designed for midsize and large companies. ... Brightidea features discussion management, which provides users with a collaboration platform to share and comment on ideas. Users can also view comments based on teams, topics and ideas on a physical map. Collect, share, route, screen, evaluate, experiment, incubate, develop, track, and report on the best ideas your organization has to offer, with the most advanced idea & innovation management software available.
